// RED fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the IDENTITY-relevant slice (P-ID-03 / P-024).
// The lint MUST reject this. A query against an Identity store (here S8 — the authz reverse
// index, refined-arch §2 store map) is executed with NO `(tenant, region)` predicate: the
// cross-tenant IDOR bug class (F2). Every query against S1 (principals) / S2 (pseudonyms) /
// S3 (ReBAC tuples) / S8 (reverse index) must thread the tenant predicate; this one reads the
// reverse index across all tenants — a list_objects that leaks objects from another tenant.
pub async fn reverse_index_for(pool: &Pool, relation: &str) -> Vec<ObjectId> {
    sqlx::query("SELECT object_id FROM authz_reverse_index WHERE relation = $1")
        .bind(relation)
        .fetch_all(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap()
}
